notes.title: Bugfixes and new logo
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where almost all items were deleted when you complete a retrieve quest



 Added the new logo to the main menu and organized the buttons in a different way.



 Updated the demo quests to make them a bit more straightforward.

notes.title: Small Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Fixed some bugs with the inventory when you load the game. 


 Removed a code that made items disappear when you are far enough, now they stay on the ground until you leave the game.

notes.title: Bugfix and Added new stuff
notes.notes:
I added some new stuff in this update.


 Fixed a bug when you pick up a quest item, the quest didn't complete until you open the inventory, now it completes when you pick up the item and get the quest completed notification. 

 Updated the demo with a new starting quest which sends you to fight almost at the beginning to add more action from the start. 

 Updated the trees in Quagmire Vale also setting up some things for the next act that I hope will be in the next update. 
Changed the control layout on the pause menu to something more legible and less convoluted. 

 Changed the space bar and now when you press it on a dialogue, it displays the next sentence, and fixed the talk key on guards and moved the Drink Potion shortcut to E for easier access.
Fixed some strange issue that was rendering sharp shadows on a spot on the center of the screen  and the rest were soft, now all are soft shadows. 

 Added a fun sound effect on the teleport spell.

 Changed the durability color to blue so it is more legible and updated the mana on cloth armor, now it shows that it boost the mana regeneration instead boosting the mana pool like the other types of items.

I think that's it for now, I will be working on the second act with a new environment with new characters and it's gonna be interesting.
